privacy.ai_training_note: Artbreeder uses StyleGAN trained on FFHQ (Flickr-Faces-HQ) dataset, publicly licensed Creative Commons images from Flickr. User-generated images are released to public domain under CC0 license by default in free tier. Paid Pro subscribers can enable private mode to keep images permanently private even if subscription ends. No evidence that user-generated content is used to retrain models.
